prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern office meeting room bathed in soft, natural daylight from large windows, with a view of a city skyline faintly visible outside. Three professionally dressed men stand near a whiteboard mounted on a wood-paneled wall; one man in a white shirt and dark trousers gestures toward the board, another in a green sweater and khakis faces him, and a third in a light pink shirt and dark pants stands to the side, holding a marker. The whiteboard features a playful, hand-drawn chart titled "FAILLES D'EXPRESSION" with cartoonish monkeys climbing ladders, adding a whimsical touch to the corporate setting. To the right, a large brass gong on a stand adds an unusual, quirky element. In the foreground, a woman with long dark hair, dressed in business attire, sits at a desk with a computer, paperwork, and office supplies, focused on her work. The overall color palette is muted and professional, with earthy tones from the wood paneling and neutral office furniture, contrasted by the bright white of the board and the soft daylight. The composition is balanced, with a slight cinematic depth of field that keeps the main subjects in sharp focus while gently blurring the background, evoking a candid, documentary-style atmosphere that captures both the seriousness and subtle humor of a collaborative office environment.
